protocol: NLSY97 external replication v1, fixed before inspecting person-level values

person_split.algorithm: SHA256 of NLSY97-replication-v1: plus canonical integer public respondent ID; first 8 hex digits mod 10

rule_multi_horizon: All evaluated outcomes must lie within their assigned calendar block; no future outcomes or confirmation participants enter training or development
endpoint: civilian employment at explicitly defined weekly control points; exact week/date mapping must be documented from official crosswalk before conversion
scope: Age-appropriate external replication; RLMS 50-64 age group cannot be imposed on this birth cohort
quality_rule: Preserve missing/ambiguous weekly states and imputation/denial/backreport flags; no blanket recoding of all non-employer codes as nonemployment
holdout_rule: Do not compute confirmation performance, outcome frequencies or label-dependent filters during acquisition/schema preparation; record any later confirmation access
remaining_before_experiments: confirm variable reference codes and weekly time crosswalk
fix mappings and candidate hyperparameters on training/development only
record final complete experimental configuration before first confirmation metrics
interpretation: Initial reserve protocol, not a claim that the complete scientific preregistration is already finished
